Hi Anya — great notes. Quick answers and clarifications from the field side so you can take these to Security/Facilities: 

1) Signed offline images and chain-of-trust:
- We will provide a signed image tarball for each appliance model. Each tarball includes a SHA256 checksum and a detached GPG signature. We can provide our signing key fingerprint and a short audit of the signing process for your Security team.
- No automatic downloads or background updates are required; upgrades are applied from removable media (USB or local staging server) only in air-gapped mode.

2) Local telemetry & logs:
- Appliance stores operational logs and tokenized inference metrics (latency, error rates). Model inputs are not transmitted offbox in any deployment mode unless you opt into a secure, customer-controlled telemetry export. We can sign an attestation for this behavior.

3) Offline upgrade/rollback flow (high-level):
- Stage signed image on local staging host; verify checksum and signature.
- Put appliance in maintenance mode; snapshot local config.
- Apply upgrade from removable media; perform smoke tests (self-check, checksum verification).
- If failure, automatic rollback to last known-good image (takes ~20 minutes).

4) Hardware/spares recommendation:
- For pilot (3 units): 1 onsite spare GPU board, 1 spare PSU, and a spare NVMe module. If you prefer Redwood-managed spares, we can ship and hold them under an RMA agreement.
- Typical power draw under load ~950W; recommend 30A PDU headroom per appliance.

Next steps I’ll take this week:

- Book a 30-min sizing call with Diana/Kwan + your Facilities lead for Thu 29 Apr, 10:00–10:30 PT.
